target_customer: Law firms and legal teams negotiating contracts, plus AI tool builders needing redlines
problem: Managing document versions and redlines in legal work is slow and risky.
business_model: B2B SaaS and API (pricing not found)
product_category: legal document comparison and version control

technical_complexity.rationale: Accurate Word and PDF diffing is non-trivial; the site says a Rust engine is used (current, not necessarily at founding).

defensibility.rationale: Established redline vendors exist; a customer on the site says they switched from Litera.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No action against the company found.

market_need_then: No dated source describing demand for this product at the time of founding was found, so the market need at founding is unknown and is not inferred here.

rebrands.why: YC page now markets as Git for Lawyers within Claude; whether a formal rebrand is unclear

brand_strength.rationale: Git for Lawyers line is a clear analogy but no press or community evidence found.

outcome_analysis: Version Story entered YC Winter 2021 and by 2026 sells document comparison, track and merge tools through a web app, REST API and Claude and ChatGPT connectors. Customer logos are shown but no funding amounts, revenue or outcome are public, so success cannot be judged from the sources found.
notes: Extruct lists Accel, 10X Capital, Gaingels and YC as seed investors with no amounts; single aggregator so no round recorded. Team size conflicts (6 vs 30). Founding year conflicts (2020, 2021). No dated competitors found.
